episodes.title: Tess
episodes.summary: Diagnosed with Leber's Neuropathy, homicide detective Tess Avery quits the police force after nearly getting her partner, Jake Campbell, killed. Unwilling to accept help, or even admit her new reality, Tess turns to an assistive app to help navigate the world around her while still "passing" as sighted. Through the EyesUP app, Tess finds an unorthodox partner in Sunny Patel, an overly enthusiastic seeing eye guide working from her home in New York City who helps Tess investigate the brutal abduction of a young mother who may still be alive. But Sunny has a secret: she's an agoraphobe who only leaves her apartment through the eyes of her clients, and is hiding a violent event in her own past

episodes.title: Sunny
episodes.summary: When the hit and run victim from one of Tess' former cases awakes from a coma, Sunny encourages Tess to track down new leads even though she's no longer on the force. Tess' ex-partner Jake Campbell inherits Tess' case files along with a new partner, Leo Li, who is quick to dismiss the case as a dead end. As Tess makes progress, she discovers the incident is connected to a notorious unsolved murder. Meanwhile, Tess' best friend Matt encourages Tess to open up about her vision loss to Jake. Sunny, desperate to help Tess find leads, reveals her surprising financial situation and a dilemma on her doorstep – the very doorstep of her apartment that she is terrified to cross.

episodes.title: Jake
episodes.summary: When Tess inserts herself into Jake's investigation to find the identity of a dead "John Doe," she confronts conflicting emotions – fearing for her brother Lucas' life, while driven to do the thing she loves most: solve the case. Tess continues to resist the traditional sight impaired training offered by her vision loss consultant, Mia, preferring to rely on Sunny's remote guidance – until an unexpected crisis and a nudge from Matt forces her to reconsider. Meanwhile, Sunny is served divorce papers after failing to meet her husband for a date, leaving her concierge, Kye, as her only real-life contact with the outside world.

episodes.title: Mia
episodes.summary: Jake encourages Tess to talk to Superintendent Bennett about getting her old job back, but her hopes are cut short by his disappointing offer to join the Metro PD in a desk role. Frustrated, Tess takes on an unsolved murder of a woman killed in her delivery van, allowing her to bring justice to an overlooked victim while proving her old boss wrong. Tess accepts a lesson in cane navigation from Mia, but Sunny is never far from her ear – except when she gets cut off, just as Tess goes on a date with a potential killer.

episodes.title: Matt
episodes.summary: With Tess now back on duty as a police consultant, and Sunny as her under the radar tech partner, a close to home murder of one of Matt's colleagues challenges the duo on their first ‘on the books' case in the pool where Tess swims. As they investigate the mystery surrounding the swim coach's death, and the dynamics of her Olympic-level swim team, Tess and Sunny discover they were on opposite ends of the popularity scale in school. Mia offers her unexpected skills to the case and a shaken Matt sees a new side of Tess. Meanwhile, Sunny is desperate for help with a DIY job gone awry and lets her concierge, Kye, into her apartment, reawakening past trauma.

episodes.title: Lucas
episodes.summary: Tess is quick to question Lucas' motive when he claims to need a place to crash in the middle of the night, only to later unearth a bombshell with Jake at a crime scene that suggests her brother may be implicated in the murder of a famous painter. Torn between her loyalty to the Homicide Division and the need to protect the only family she has left, Tess says nothing to Jake, instead turning to Sunny to watch over Lucas via a nanny cam while she attempts to solve the case. Meanwhile, Sunny invites Kye into her home to help with her DIY renovation, but he stumbles onto a piece of her hidden past, breaking her fragile trust.

episodes.title: Leo
episodes.summary: Tess and Jake investigate the shooting of a trucker when the Vice Squad shows up, demanding Metro PD cut their main suspect loose before they compromise an ongoing investigation. When the same suspect is found dead in the interrogation room, both squads are thrown under suspicion and the station is put into lockdown, turning up the heat on Tess and Jake's investigation. The stakes spiral when Jake's life is put into peril and Tess is cut off when the power goes out in Sunny's building. Meanwhile, Kye and Sunny's relationship deepens until Sunny overhears a suspicious phone call.

episodes.title: Fluffed
episodes.summary: Tess and Sunny explore themes of hidden identity as they investigate the murder of a realtor's assistant in a glossy mansion he was preparing to sell, only to discover that neither the realtor, nor the buyers he was prepping the mansion for, are who they seem to be. As the investigation goes on, Tess discovers Sunny might have secrets of her own. Meanwhile, Sunny confronts Kye after catching him eavesdropping.

episodes.title: Burn Notice
episodes.summary: The sensational disappearance of two influencers who travel the country posting their van life adventures has Tess and Matt tracing their trail on an epic road trip – with Sunny riding shotgun through the car speakers. Unbeknownst to Sunny, Tess leverages the case to lower Sunny's guard and reveal more about her past. Jake is quickly brought on the case when the three locate the burned-out van at the bottom of a wooded ravine, creating complications on the personal front. Returning to the college, Matt enlists Mia's help using her pull with the low vision community to dig into Sunny's employment at EyesUp, confirming Tess' worst fears.

episodes.title: Razor's Edge
episodes.summary: Tess and Sunny's relationship is put to the ultimate test when Tess reveals she knows who Sunny really is and why she needs to hide from the outside world. To prove Tess wrong, Sunny must face her deepest fear and relive the crime that sent her into hiding. On the verge of losing Tess' trust, Sunny guides her through the abandoned crime scene, reliving the night that changed her life in an emotionally charged flashback – with Tess as a witness and interrogator. Sunny's story leads Tess to evidence that bring her onside. But, in doing so, they draw the attention of a greater foe.

episodes.title: Runaway Bride
episodes.summary: Tess and Sunny join forces with Jake to investigate the murder of an unidentified bride found dead on a desolate beach, still wearing her wedding gown. As they dig into the case, they discover the bride and her fiancée were once on opposite sides of the law, running from a dark past that has caught up to them. The case hits close to home for Sunny, who's haunted by the home invasion she suffered in the Season 1 finale, while Mia helps Tess confront a troubling new symptom of her sight loss. As the team races against time, secrets and betrayals come to light, setting the stage for a suspenseful season.

episodes.title: About a Boy
episodes.summary: A routine stop turns into a parent's worst nightmare when a 6-year-old boy is abducted during a carjacking. Tess and Jake race against time to rescue the child, tracking the kidnapper's potential motivations and leading to a tense standoff. As the case culminates in a high-speed chase, Tess's empathy helps defuse a potentially fatal situation, reuniting the boy with his family, and forcing Tess to reflect on her own troubled family dynamics. Meanwhile, Sunny immerses herself in the case to avoid her own trauma, while Matt begins to move on from Tess.

episodes.title: Chain Reaction
episodes.summary: Tess and Leo find themselves trapped inside a chemical plant when an active shooter targets the facility's manager. While trying to evacuate workers, Tess must navigate the highly dangerous, flammable environment with Sunny's remote guidance. As they race against time, Tess works to outsmart the gunman to save Leo and prevent a deadly explosion, while Matt and Mia step in to provide critical assistance. Meanwhile, Tess and Sunny are each hit with unsettling personal news.

episodes.title: Murder on the Dancefloor
episodes.summary: Tess and Sunny must unravel complicated family dynamics in what appears to be a chilling mother-daughter murder-suicide at a prestigious dance academy. As they dig deeper into the tight-knit dance community, the pair uncover dark secrets and a highly intelligent killer. With Jake away, Tess and Leo are faced with their new, overly enthusiastic colleague, detective Owen Cooper, who brings fresh but chaotic energy to the case. Meanwhile, Sunny suspects an intruder is breaking into her home as she sleeps, heightening her paranoia. Matt and Mia try to help Tess re-live a positive childhood memory, but discover they share unexpected chemistry with each other instead.

episodes.title: Girls Like Us
episodes.summary: Tess, Sunny, and Jake team up to solve the high-profile murder of a controversial speaker on the college lecture circuit amid intense campus protests. The team learns to navigate the unfamiliar world of Trad Wives and their detractors in an effort to find the killer, but when Matt leaks footage of an officer and protester it threatens to derail the investigation. Meanwhile, Sunny faces fallout from her sleepwalking, putting her relationship with Kye at risk.

episodes.title: Lost in Translation
episodes.summary: A sleep-deprived Sunny has the day off, as Tess gets pulled into a 911 call with an injured man locked in a steel drum who has no idea who, or where, he is. As Tess navigates motives of revenge and a business rivalry in a race against time to uncover the location of the victim, Sunny takes drastic actions to maintain her fragile sense of safety, convinced she witnessed a murder on her building's CCTV cameras. As the case culminates in a dramatic end, Tess struggles with revealing her own hidden truths to rescue the victim.

episodes.title: Family Matters
episodes.summary: Tess investigates a pastor's daughter, whose sudden disappearance stirs deep tensions within her devout family and close-knit community. As Tess digs into the young woman's world, she uncovers a hidden life, exposing long-standing conflicts within her family. But when a trusted figure within their church is violently attacked, Tess finds herself questioning whether the young woman is truly a victim. Meanwhile, Sunny is forced to confront her own unresolved family issues, as she uncovers digital clues that shed light on the young woman's double life.

episodes.title: Don't Look Back
episodes.summary: Tess is forced to revisit her legally blind diagnosis when a lawyer leverages her vision loss as grounds to open a case involving her eyewitness testimony, which could put the case and her consulting role with the police at risk. When Bennett and the rest of the department keep Tess at arms' length, she begrudgingly accepts the help of new detective Owen Cooper to solve the case a second time. In an attempt to work through the mounting pressure, Sunny begins sessions with her new therapist.

episodes.title: Strangers in a Game
episodes.summary: Tess and Sunny pursue a killer who uses an untraceable ghost gun to take down powerful victims with no discernable connection to each other. As the threat of a spree killer looms over Metro PD, Leo asks for Tess's support to investigate the anonymity of digital worlds where dark alliances and online fantasies have real life consequences. With Matt's help, Tess and Sunny work against the clock to dissect perfect alibis and expose the killer before another life is taken. Meanwhile, Sunny gets carried away in her healing journey.

episodes.title: Rekindling
episodes.summary: Tess reunites with Jake on an undercover mission to dismantle a criminal network from within. The operation takes a turn when Tess comes face-to-face with the man she believes killed her mother 20 years ago, forcing her to perform a delicate balancing act as she tries to get to the truth while keeping Jake safe from the murderous gang he's infiltrated. Meanwhile, Sunny's actions catch up to her after she takes a risk in an attempt to convince herself that she has cured her agoraphobia.
